relevant_files.description: Gateway route registry — aggregates all route modules (platform, content, agents, workflow, admin, m10, m11) and provides route matching logic.
Platform routes: health, metrics, tools, models, config (GET/PUT/POST), secrets (GET/PUT/POST), reload.
Content routes: chat, memory, workspace, graph, wiki, writing, writing-craft, plugins, sync, foreshadow, character, analysis, learning, story-bible, qc, cowriting, reader simulation.
Agent routes: agent route/write/revise/context, critic evaluate/suggestions/consistency, consistency check, skills list/load/match/chain/create/save/delete.
Workflow routes: route/plan/execute/lifecycle/rollback, revision session CRUD, scheduler CRUD, checkpoint CRUD, UI bridge wrappers.
Admin routes: MCP service CRUD (list, create, update, delete, enable, probe).
M10 routes: revise-multi-pass, style extract/apply/profile, cross-chapter consistency, context-aware suggestions.
M11 routes: worldview extract, worldview get by projectId.
Barrel export for all endpoint handlers — re-exports from 25+ endpoint files and external modules (knowledge/mcp, cowriting/mcp, reader/mcp).
Health check endpoint with gateway dependency injection, diagnostic classification, engine health probes for 5 core services.
Config endpoints: getConfig (with secret masking), updateConfig (field whitelist), getSecrets/updateSecrets (localhost guard), reloadConfig.
Chat endpoints: chat (workflow-driven with canon context injection), chatStream (SSE streaming with adaptive chunking).
Agent endpoints: route, write (with workspace resolution), revise (with feedback object), context. Delegates to mcp/services/agent.
Critic endpoints: evaluate, suggestions, consistency (cross-chapter with character/timeline/worldview checkers), workspace scanner CLI.
Workflow endpoints: route/plan/execute/lifecycle/rollback, revision CRUD, scheduler CRUD, checkpoint CRUD, UI bridge wrappers (gate on uiBridgeEnabled).
Memory endpoints: search, add, upload (base64 decode + DocumentLoader + chunking), temporal. Resolves workspace scope for entityId/projectId/sessionId.
Graph endpoints: query (Cypher with blocked pattern filter), character, foreshadows, foreshadow plant/stats, character profile/depth/relationships.
Wiki endpoints: promote (create canon page), list (with status filter), read page (by slug). Delegates to mcp/services/wiki.
Skills endpoints: list (by category), load (by skill_id), match (by task_type/keywords/issue), chain (by task_type), create/save/delete (file-based CRUD in ~/.niko/skills).
MCP Admin endpoints: service list, create, update, delete, enable/disable, probe health. Write endpoints protected by localhost-only guard (ISS-004).
Writing endpoints: novel quality check (delegates to critic evaluateContent), writing helper process (local or LLM with skill injection), writing stream (SSE with LLM streaming).
Writing craft analysis endpoints: analyze (9 dimensions via keyword-based analyzers), emotional arc, voice consistency, reader immersion, pacing navigator.
Writing craft LLM endpoint: LLM-powered deep analysis for 9 dimensions with OpenAI-compatible API calls, JSON response parsing, per-dimension error handling.
Analysis endpoints: patterns (Cypher-based pattern detection with templates), sessions (placeholder), narrative visualization (consistency + graph + bundle builder).
Plugin endpoints: list (from pluginEngine), execute (by pluginId/pluginIds), register (dynamic rule-based plugin creation with regex detection).
Sync endpoints: status, push, pull, full. SSRF protection via validateRemoteUrl (rejects private IPs, localhost, link-local). Uses SyncEngine with LocalStorageAdapter and RemoteStorageAdapter.
Learning endpoints: import, style feedback, style drift, rules, reading session, reading extract, status. CAP-001/002/003 placeholder implementations.
M10 style endpoints: extract (text analysis for avg sentence length, vocab richness, dialogue ratio, tense, POV), profile (by projectId), apply (style guidance generation).
M10 consistency endpoints: cross-chapter (name conflicts, timeline issues, unresolved threads, trait drifts with graph enrichment), context-aware suggestions (search-based).
M10 revision endpoint: multi-pass revision with RevisionServiceImpl, target score, max iterations, chapter_id. Returns revised content with iteration count and final decision.
M11 worldview endpoints: extract (WorldviewExtractor.quickExtract), get (by projectId, returns empty placeholder).
Workspace endpoint: context normalization and summary. Resolves workspace root and returns ProjectWorkspaceContext with compatibility info.
Reader simulation endpoints: analyze, personas, custom persona, overlay, ai-flavor, feedback, compare, de-ai. Heavy validation, caching, DualEngine integration.
Story Bible endpoints: entity list/get/create/update/delete, extract from manuscript (placeholder), completeness report. In-memory storage with novel indexing.
QC endpoints: validate output (heuristic quality checks with cache), creativity config (preset resolution).
Co-writing endpoints: generate auto (AutoMode), generate guided (GuidedMode), get modes, get creativity presets. Placeholder input builders (ISS-20260620-016).
Agent service: agentRoute, agentWrite, agentRevise, agentGetContext. Called by agent endpoints.
Critic service: evaluateContent, getImprovementSuggestions. Called by critic and writing endpoints.
Workflow service: route, plan, execute, lifecycle, rollback, scheduler CRUD, checkpoint CRUD. Called by workflow endpoints.
Memory service: search, add, getTemporal. Called by memory endpoints.
Graph service: query, getCharacter, getForeshadows, getRelationships, addEntity. Called by graph endpoints.
Wiki service: listProjectWikiCanonPages, promoteProjectWikiCanon, readProjectWikiCanonPage. Called by wiki endpoints.
Skills service: list, load, match, getChain. Called by skills endpoints.
Search service: hybrid search, iterative search, context search. Called by chat and memory endpoints.
Type definitions for GatewayRoute, EndpointHandler, HttpMethod, GatewayRouteMatch.
HTTP type definitions: HttpRequest, HttpResponse, jsonResponse, parseBody, and SSE helpers.
Input validation utilities: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot, tryResolveWorkspaceRoot, validateStringLength. Used by most endpoints.
MCP configuration: gateway host/port resolution, CORS origins, reload enabled, localhost-only guard.
MCP service configuration: MCP_SERVICE_CONFIGS, health cache, serializeServiceConfig, updateServiceConfig.

code_anchors.finding: Health check probes 5 core engines via gatewayDeps injection. Missing gatewayDeps returns 503. Each engine health check is wrapped in try/catch. Diagnostic classification uses regex patterns to categorize failures (parser_missing, embedding_authority_unavailable, packaged_prerequisite_missing, integration_degraded, runtime_unavailable).

Secrets endpoint protected by localhost-only guard (ISS-002). Checks remoteAddress against 127.0.0.1, ::1, ::ffff:127.0.0.1. No remoteAddress = internal/test call, allowed by default. Requires configAccess injection.

Chat input validation: MAX_MESSAGES=128, MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS=24000, MAX_TOTAL_CHARS=120000. Validates message array, role enum, content type and length, total character count. Returns 400 for any validation failure.

Graph query endpoint blocks destructive Cypher operations via regex patterns: DETACH DELETE, DROP, CREATE CONSTRAINT/INDEX, REMOVE label. Returns 403 for blocked patterns. Only read-only queries allowed.

Memory upload validates file_name, file_content_base64, session_id. Base64 validation includes regex pattern check, length divisibility by 4, and round-trip verification. DocumentLoader parses file (supports multiple formats). Errors wrapped in DocumentLoadError for structured response.

Writing helper has dual path: local processing (no LLM config) or LLM call. Local mode does not support 'generate'. LLM config resolved from headers (X-LLM-API-Key, X-LLM-Base-Url) or body fields. Error messages scrubbed for credentials before logging/returning. Detection evasion guard adds system prompt for natural prose.

SSRF protection in sync endpoints. validateRemoteUrl rejects: non-http(s) schemes, localhost, loopback (127.x.x.x), private IPs (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16), link-local (169.254), multicast (224-239), reserved (240+), IPv6 ULA (fc/fd), IPv6 link-local (fe80:).
